latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of optometrist-video skill.

- Assists optometry practices in creating short videos for new patient introductions and eyewear collection showcases.
- Guides users through selecting video type and key practice details, including technology, collection style, and patient demographic.
- Generates a 60–90 second script with recommended b-roll suggestions.
- Focuses on highlighting advanced diagnostic equipment, patient care philosophy, and engaging doctor–patient interactions.
- Emphasizes bright, modern settings and warm, authentic staff presentations.
